summary: Stranded vendor credit posted to suspense due to multi-PO currency mismatch — requires reclassification and payrun inclusion
currency_issues: Credit note submitted in EUR while original invoices were posted in USD and GBP. Automated FX matching failed and system posted to suspense account.
description: Vendor submitted a single credit note intended to cover three historic invoices tied to three different POs. The credit note arrived in EUR; the ledger entries for the original invoices are in USD (PO-78921) and GBP (PO-78922, PO-78923). The AP ingestion job (ap-ingest-v2) failed FX reconciliation and routed the credit to the Suspense Clearing GL (GL-9999). The payrun engine excludes entries in Suspense which left the credit stranded and caused payrun reconciliation differences for the 2026-03-09 fortnightly payrun.
impact: Credit not applied to vendor account; vendor expected refund or allocation. Payrun reconciliation shows a EUR 18.45k variance. Potential vendor relationship risk and month-end AR/AP imbalance if not corrected before next close.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Vendor sends a consolidated credit note covering multiple invoice/PO currencies.
2) Upload credit note PDF to AP intake SFTP folder (ap-inbound/eu/nordic).
3) ap-ingest-v2 processes file during nightly batch; FX lookup fails due to missing historical rate for one invoice date.
4) System posts credit to Suspense GL-9999 instead of matching to invoice IDs.
5) Run payrun reconciliation; entry excluded because GL-9999 is not mapped for payrun inclusion.

resolution: Temporary workaround applied: Treasury posted manual reclassification journals (JNL-7812) to move EUR 18,450 from Suspense GL-9999 to vendor account GL-2301 so the payrun reconciliation could include the credit. Payrun re-run completed 2026-03-12 and variance cleared. Follow-up actions: (1) Engineering to add daily midpoint fallback in ap-ingest-v2 FX lookup (PR referenced above) and add unit test for historical rate misses; (2) Finance to perform GL cleanup and post any FX adjustments as part of March close; (3) Update AP intake runbook to require vendor currency on consolidated credits.
